caption: The drawing features a single, vertically oriented object resembling a candlestick holder, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil or ink on a beige or off-white background. The object is centrally placed and detailed with intricate, repetitive patterns throughout its structure. The base is octagonal and appears faceted with multiple layers stacked in a stepped formation, each tier decorated with fine vertical lines suggesting a cut-glass or crystal texture. Rising from the base, the stem alternates between rounded, bulbous segments and narrower, ribbed sections. The uppermost portion broadens to form a shallow cup or holder with a similarly intricate edge, comprised of repeating, rounded shapes and bordered by small bead-like details. The overall surface of the object is highly detailed and the composition is devoid of additional items or background elements, with only the artist’s name “John Dana” inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Candlestick
